title: Russian — GOST 7.79-2000 System A (= ISO 9:1995)
authority: GOST 7.79-2000 (interstate standard, in force in Russia since 01.07.2002), System A; ISO 9:1995
description: One-to-one, reversible transliteration with diacritics (ISO 9:1995, adopted as GOST 7.79-2000 System A, the interstate standard of Russia and the CIS): Ё→Ë, Ж→Ž, Х→H, Ц→C, Щ→Ŝ, Ю→Û, Я→Â, Ъ→ʺ, Ь→ʹ.
notes: Pre-1918 letters per ISO 9: І→ì, Ѣ→ě, Ѳ→f̀ (f + U+0300), Ѵ→ỳ.
iuliia's JSON outputs Cyrillic ё for Ё (data bug); this scheme uses Latin ë (U+00EB).
Ъ = U+02BA (ʺ), Ь = U+02B9 (ʹ). GOST 7.79 allows ASCII substitutes (" and ') in some environments; they are not used here.
samples: Юлия, съешь ещё этих мягких французских булок из Йошкар-Олы, да выпей алтайского чаю
